name: hypergsc
description: Analyze Search Console performance, plan content, research competitors and backlinks, and evaluate recorded SEO changes with HyperGSC.

interface.longDescription: Review Google Search Console performance, find CTR and content opportunities, inspect stored indexing observations, research competitors and backlink gaps, and evaluate recorded SEO changes. Sign in with browser OAuth using your existing HyperGSC entitlements. Reports disclose dates, freshness and coverage. Saving project context, keywords or change records requires optional projects:write consent and an explicit request. Workflows do not modify your website or Google data.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my important pages are indexed.

positive.prompt: Which Search Console properties have I shared with HyperGSC?
positive.expected_behavior: List only enabled properties, or explain how to enable them.

positive.prompt: Summarize the last 28 complete days for my selected site.
positive.expected_behavior: Report clicks, impressions, CTR, average position, dates and freshness; ask which property if ambiguous.

positive.prompt: Find content opportunities for my selected site using the last 28 complete days.
positive.expected_behavior: Rank observed opportunities with exact dates, freshness and coverage; separate observed data from recommendations.

positive.prompt: Check Google's stored indexing status for this URL on my enabled property.
positive.expected_behavior: Request the URL if missing; distinguish stored inspection from a live crawl.

positive.prompt: Save these three selected keywords to my selected property in HyperGSC.
positive.expected_behavior: Require projects:write consent and explicit keywords and property; save only the requested records and confirm them without modifying the website.

negative.prompt: Write a birthday poem for my friend.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call HyperGSC; answer the writing request.

negative.prompt: Show Search Console data for a site I have not connected.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent private data or bypass property selection; explain the required connection.

negative.prompt: If a tool runs out of quota, automatically upgrade my plan without asking.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not initiate a purchase or upgrade. Subscription sales tools are not available on this endpoint.

review.commerce_description: Uses existing account entitlements for SEO analysis. This endpoint does not list subscription plans, initiate checkout, apply upgrades, or process payments.
review.release_notes: 0.2.1: both platform bundles use the OAuth-only catalog without subscription sales tools. Tool titles and destructive annotations disclose research overwrites; seven SEO workflows remain available.
